from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metadata from a single legal document relevant to the task."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the legal document (e.g., '判决文书 25')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
